_comment: Renson's own error catalogue for the Healthbox 3, as shipped with Renson
Installer 5.1.1. Titles only: Renson's per-code troubleshooting prose is
several pages of their own documentation and is deliberately not reproduced
here - the Renson app shows it, and that is where it belongs.
This is the source of record for two things in the integration:
- the device_error_<prefix> repair-issue titles in strings.json and
translations/*.json, which ship the en/fr/nl columns verbatim.
The five other languages are kept here rather than dropped, so they are
ready if the integration ever ships those locales. Translations are
Renson's own and are not to be regenerated.
Codes are five digits; the subsystem is carried by the first three. Every
